summary: Run every web CI lane when an event diff cannot be determined, while preserving input-scoped kit plays for known PR, merge-queue and push diffs.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No application or API change. Unknown web CI diffs select all lanes rather than failing detection before execution. Known diffs retain PR merge-base, merge-group base-to-head and push before-to-after selection; existing check names and gate failure semantics are unchanged.
